public_paragraph: In Upendra Kishore Das’s ମଲାଜହ୍ନ (Malajanha), Satyabhama is about to go out when her father calls her back. Later, she listens from the doorway as her parents discuss finding her a groom. The first-person telling lets us hear the girl whose future the adults are discussing.[^malajanha-text] Nitai Palit brought the novel to the screen in 1965; the opening credits retain Das’s name above the title.[^malajanha-film]
